title: Electrum wallet files
whyItMatters: Electrum keeps one file per wallet, encrypted with the wallet password, plus labels and addresses. A copy lets someone try passwords offline and link the person to their Bitcoin.
source: Electrum documentation, Where is the Electrum datadir located: https://docs.electrum.org/en/latest/faq.html
notes: One file per wallet, default_wallet on a fresh install. The parent folder holds config, logs and blockchain headers. A wallet saved elsewhere by the user is only caught by the personal-folder rules.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for every wallet, and copy any wallet file you still need to a drive you keep.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup before removing anything.
Open Electrum and check that every wallet opens and is backed up.
Uninstall Electrum from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Electrum wallet folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Deleted wallet files cannot be recovered without the wallet password or seed; funds stay on the blockchain but access can be lost.
